name: Pippu (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Pippu town emblem in yellow: a stylised letter W with pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Pippu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 17 July 1954.

features.role: Pippu town emblem — a stylised letter W with pointed strokes
